FAQ

Is AimTrainerPro really free?

Yes, all core training exercises are completely free with no hidden costs.

Do I need to create an account?

No account is required to start training. Sign up only if you want to save progress and appear on leaderboards.

Will this actually improve my aim in-game?

Consistent practice with our drills builds muscle memory that directly translates to better performance in FPS games.

What browsers are supported?

AimTrainerPro works on all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari.
